12 people: the load line

Real scaling is cyclical.

Cycle 3 of 3

Up

Up for growth.

Revenue expands, reach grows, capacity stretches

Side

Side for stability.

Down

Down for pruning.

Nothing moves forward until the cycle completes. But when it does, the next cycle starts higher.
